text: The current connectedCallback returns if shadowRoot already exists, before attachShadow and clone append. This is the exact local one-initialization contract. Proposed focused test: remove and reinsert a row, then verify the same root and one set of slots. The existing inspected test checks slot identity once and does not test reconnection. Do not extrapolate this guard to every component’s listener lifecycle. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: Calendar row reconnect should retain one shadow root and one cloned template
